title_how: Energy-as-a-Service: backup power as a shared asset

flow.detail: Sale-leaseback of carriers' site batteries and generators; carrier frees capex, O&M and diesel logistics
Swap lead-acid for LFP packs plus smart controllers; add solar-hybrid at off-grid and weak-grid sites
10-year backup-as-a-service contracts with availability SLA and escalators, on top of the tower lease
Aggregate spare battery capacity of thousands of sites and bid it into frequency, capacity and peak markets

payers.pays_for: Monthly backup-as-a-service fee per site with guaranteed availability SLA
Frequency regulation and reserve capacity from aggregated site batteries
Capacity and demand-response payments for peak shaving at site level
Solar-hybrid power per kWh delivered, replacing diesel runs and fuel logistics

title_market: A large energy bill and cheaper batteries

stats.label: Share of telecom network opex spent on energy, rising with 5G densification
Average stationary storage battery pack price in 2025, down 45% year on year
US virtual power plant capacity by 2030 that could cut grid costs ~US$10B per year

rows.item: Capex: buy-in plus 20 kWh LFP upgrade

unit_economics.note: Illustrative, not quotes: 20 kWh LFP per site, fee set below carrier's own cost, grid revenue only where markets admit aggregated batteries.

title_plan: Proven by telcos; a towerco can scale it

precedents.name: Elisa DES (Finland)
precedents.what: Telco turned base-station batteries into a VPP; first distributed asset pre-qualified by Fingrid for aFRR; 150 MWh rollout planned

precedents.name: DNA Tower Finland (Telenor)
precedents.what: First tower company to sell base-station battery capacity into grid reserve markets, aiming to cover most of its sites

precedents.name: ATC Africa power-as-a-service
precedents.what: American Tower invested 350M+ USD since 2018 in solar and lithium at African sites, saving ~43.5M liters of diesel a year

plan.milestones: Pilot 500 US and 500 Brazil/Africa sites with one anchor carrier; TSO/ISO pre-qualification; measure SLA uptime and grid revenue
First portfolio sale-leaseback (5-10k sites); 2nd carrier signed; solar-hybrid at off-grid sites; enter 2-3 grid markets
20k+ sites aggregated as one VPP; third-party sites and utilities as clients; infra-fund co-investment vehicle

kpis: Grid revenue per site per year (US$)
Diesel liters avoided at hybrid sites
